reviews.text:
While the pet itself was examined well, the owner was not asked about their pet's usual behavior and was only given a one-sided explanation of "this is our policy, so please do this."

Furthermore, the explanation lacked specificity, and it felt like we were being forced to understand things based on feelings. If it was difficult to put into words, I wish they had been more empathetic towards the owner.

Since everyone else has given high ratings, I think it was probably just a matter of compatibility between the staff and the owner.

This is the veterinary hospital where we've taken our dog for neutering and vaccinations in the past. 🐶

This time, our beloved dog fractured a bone, and we visited the hospital once a week for about a month and a half.

When we heard about the fracture, we thought surgery involving general anesthesia and a plate insertion would be necessary, but they suggested treatment with a 3D cast, and we learned that there were alternatives to surgery. 🦴

Each time, they explained the current condition and the progress of the treatment carefully and clearly, so we were able to visit with peace of mind!

They also thoughtfully considered how to best care for our dog in the future, taking into account his condition and personality, which was very reassuring. ☺️

Not only the doctor, but all the staff were incredibly kind. They not only examined our dog but also took care of him and played with him while we waited for our owner to pick him up. 🥺

Our dog is naturally afraid of hospitals, but thanks to everyone's kind treatment, he was able to enjoy his visits.

This is a very trustworthy veterinary hospital that not only provides treatment but also cares for our dog's feelings! We are so glad to have found a hospital where we can entrust our precious family member with peace of mind.


I hope to continue receiving your support in the future. 🙇🏻‍♀️

They were very kind and helpful.

They were very attentive to my requests, which was a great help.

This was my first visit to your clinic!
I had been going to a different hospital before, but I was never satisfied with the results each time, so I decided to change hospitals. After reading reviews and other information, I decided to try this hospital.
It's a bit far from my house, so I was worried, but the doctor explained everything clearly and carefully during the examination, and we discovered things about my dog's condition that I hadn't noticed before. I was very satisfied for the first time! ✨
The receptionist was also very good; she not only did her job at the reception desk but also communicated with the owners and their dogs, which left a great impression. Even before the examination, I decided, "I'm definitely going to have my dog ​​examined here from now on! ✨" 🥰
Thank you so much for today! ❤

My cat had blood in her urine, and it was close to closing time, but they examined her carefully even though it was her first visit. Thank you very much. The nurses and reception staff were also very kind and helpful.
Thank you for your feedback! We will continue to strive to provide better medical care and happiness to animals.

My husband researched and took our dog to this clinic when we were devastated after he fractured his bone for the second time. He recovered completely in a month and a half without surgery and was able to go for lots of walks, so I'm really glad we found them!

They mentioned that biting dogs are a real problem.
It was very disappointing, especially considering they're professionals.
At other hospitals, they say, "Leave it to us," and I feel completely at ease entrusting my dog ​​to them.
Thank you for your feedback! We will continue to strive to provide better medical care and happiness to animals.

I used the puppy class three times after reading reviews.

I also use this clinic as my regular vet. 🏥
The doctor and staff are kind and cheerful, so it's easy to talk to them about anything, which is a great help. 🙇‍♂️
I've been able to implement the postures I learned in the puppy class at home! ✨ I can even brush my puppy's teeth now!

The first time we came to the vet, my puppy seemed scared and barked the whole time, but now it's funny to see him wagging his tail when the doctor touches him!🤣🤣
